title: O Sexto Nome
summary: Saturday 2027-02-06. The CCT confirms each team may register six players (five starters and a reserve) and allows substitutions between series. Luk chooses Zayn (p4rkingl0t) of Academy Green as sixth player after a short test; with parental consent, the CCT approves the registration at 18:02. League scrims: Main 2-1 NRG, Blue 2-1 Dorado Gaming, White 0-2 Maryville University. IEM Dallas groups B and D open: Legacy 2-1 FaZe, Falcons 2-0 NAVI, MOUZ 2-1 Spirit, Aurora 2-0 G2.
keyEvents: 6:58 — Official CCT reply: up to six players per team, a reserve can be substituted between series with approval but not during a started MD3; documentation due 18:00 Austin time.
8:04–8:41 — Luk proposes Zayn; Tarik agrees but wants to consult the five players first; Zayn stays an Academy Green player and will not be permanently promoted.
9:32 — Short communication test with Main (Zayn in Mold's slot on Cache and Overpass).
10:18 — Tyler confesses overdue school tasks; Hai arranges study schedules; Hai tells Tyler and Lucas to stop guessing each other's intentions.
11:03–13:09 — Main vs NRG (Sniper, Griffin, AoJune, Levitate, Kim Down): Kairos win game 1, NRG win game 2, Kairos win game 3 (37 min). Main 2-1.
12:21 — IEM Dallas Group B: Legacy 2-1 FaZe (Train 11-13, Cache 13-10, Inferno 13-9, Legacy view).
14:26 — Group D: MOUZ 2-1 Spirit (Inferno Spirit 13-9, Overpass MOUZ 13-11, Train MOUZ won).
15:17 — Academy Blue 2-1 Dorado Gaming (Philip, Nordik, Young, Array, Spirax).
16:08 — Group B: Falcons 2-0 Natus Vincere (Nuke 13-8, Dust II 13-11).
16:54 — Academy White 0-2 Maryville University (Will, Lojaz, Leza, Daption, Minui).
17:37 — Group D: Aurora 2-0 G2 Esports (Cache 13-7, Nuke 13-11).

18:02 — CCT approves the registration: IGL/Rifler Atlas, AWPer Glacier, Entry Mold, Rifler MoteConHuesillo, Support/Anchor FLACOGOMEZ, Reserve p4rkingl0t (Zayn); Zayn remains Academy Green and is eligible for substitution between series.
consequences: Zayn is registered as the sixth player of Kairos Gaming for CCT North America #1 only.
The search for a permanent sixth Academy Green player continues.
canonIntroduced: CCT North America #1 allows six registered players per team; substitutions between series with approval.
p4rkingl0t (Zayn) is registered as reserve of Kairos Gaming for the CCT.
continuityNotes: The registration does not create a permanent sixth Main player or a new building.
The Group D third map of MOUZ vs Spirit has no stated score; the Legacy-FaZe third map was won 13-9 by Legacy.
Milo says Spirit are in IEM Dallas, not the CCT.
realWorldReferences: IEM Dallas teams and players, NRG, Dorado Gaming, Maryville University and the CCT are real-world references; results are fictional-canon.
confirmedFacts: Registered: Atlas (IGL/rifler), Glacier (AWPer), Mold (entry), MoteConHuesillo (rifler), FLACOGOMEZ (support/anchor), reserve p4rkingl0t (Zayn).
Legacy 2-1 FaZe; Falcons 2-0 Natus Vincere; MOUZ 2-1 Spirit; Aurora 2-0 G2 Esports (round 1 of groups B and D).
Main 2-1 NRG; Blue 2-1 Dorado; White 0-2 Maryville University; private scrims only.
unconfirmedDetails: Whether Zayn will play and any score of MOUZ-Spirit game 3.
notes: Kairos Gaming is the public name of the Counter-Strike Main team.
